userPrompt: Draft a polite reminder email about an overdue invoice.
responseText:
**Subject:** Gentle Reminder: Overdue Invoice # [Invoice Number]

Dear [Client's Name],

I hope this email finds you well.

This is a polite reminder that Invoice # [Invoice Number], issued on [Invoice Date] for $[Amount Due], is now past due. Payment was originally due by [Due Date].

Could you please let me know when we can expect the payment? I’d be happy to provide a copy of the invoice or any additional details if needed.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. I appreciate your prompt attention and continued partnership.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Your Company Name]  
[Your Contact Information]
